justification: Inspected [javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageConfig.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/zxing/zxing/javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageConfig.java), [javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageWriter.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/zxing/zxing/javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageWriter.java), and [javase/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageWriterTestCase.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/zxing/zxing/javase/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/MatrixToImageWriterTestCase.java). The target class is very small: 2 constants, 2 final fields, 2 constructors, 2 getters, 1 package-private color-model helper, and 1 private transparency helper.
